title: [trios-igla] Honest infrastructure submission — 7,534-row ledger, no model artifact

body:
## TRIOS IGLA — Honest Infrastructure Research Submission

**Track**: Non-record (infrastructure contribution)
**Author**: gHashTag · Zenodo DOI [10.5281/zenodo.19227877](https://zenodo.org/records/19227877)

---

## What we built

### Scarabaeus Fleet — Multi-account orchestration
- **6 Railway workers** across independent accounts (Acc0–Acc5)
- **Pull-based self-orchestration**: `SKIP LOCKED` Postgres claim pattern
- **~1,851 experiments tracked** via Neon `experiment_queue`
- **MEGA-ASHA** adaptive stopping (kill if BPB > 3.5 at step 4000)
- **φ-physics foundation**: learning rate α_φ = 0.004/φ³, Trinity identity φ²+φ⁻²=3

### Honest Results

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| **Honest best BPB** | **2.1505** (ID 1387, seed 4181) |
| Seeds ratified with held-out validation | 0 |
| Gate-2 target | <1.85 |
| Gate-2 result | ❌ failed |

### Why no model.bin

`record_checkpoint()` was a stub — never wrote tensors to disk. Full post-mortem in `CHECKPOINT_POSTMORTEM.md`.

### Leak investigation

42 of 1,851 experiments showed BPB < 0.01 — investigated in `LEAK_INVESTIGATION.md`. Root cause: `load_data()` synthetic-fallback identity collision (train == val). All 42 rows marked `suspected_leak` in ledger.

## Artifact

`trios-igla-1/ledger_2026-04-30.sql.gz` — 183 KB, 7,534 rows:
- `experiment_queue`: 1,851 rows
- `bpb_samples`: 5,243 rows  
- `workers`: 414 rows
- `gardener_runs`: 26 rows

## Reproducibility

- Fleet: https://github.com/gHashTag/trios-railway
- Trainer: https://github.com/gHashTag/trios-trainer-igla
- Docker: `ghcr.io/ghashtag/trios-trainer-igla`
- Neon ledger: full SQL dump attached
